reason: My cardiologist and dietitian are the ones who tell me what to eat, and this is an app from people I have never heard of. I would use the free scan at a restaurant to see if it is any good before I think about paying anything.
objection: Another subscription for something I use twice a month, and I do not know whether its colour ratings are right for my cholesterol.
would_change_my_mind: My dietitian or doctor recommends it, or the free scans turn out to match what she tells me about specific dishes.
